| [Branches](Modules/Branches.md) | api + web | The places a clinic operates from. One organization, one or many branches — a solo clinic and a hospital group are the same shape. | 6 | 3 |

| [Appointments](Modules/Appointments.md) | api + web | Booking, and the availability engine behind it. PHI: a patient, a doctor and a reason disclose more together than any one of them. Unlike `patients`, `appointments` IS branch-scoped — identity follows the person, attendance belongs to the clinic it happened at. | 21 | 2 |
| [Audit](Modules/Audit.md) | api | An append-only record of who changed what. Ids and permission codes only — never a name, never PHI. | 0 | 1 |
| [PlatformConsole](Modules/PlatformConsole.md) | api + web | What the platform operator sees. Demo-request pipeline, provisioning, and eventually impersonation. | 29 | 2 |
| [Marketing](Modules/Marketing.md) | web | The apex domain. Landing page, signup, legal pages and the demo form — everything that happens before a tenant exists. | 0 | 1 |
| [Notifications](Modules/Notifications.md) | api + worker | The seam every outbound message goes through. Real logic, no delivery. | 0 | 0 |
| [Worker](Modules/Worker.md) | worker | Background jobs on BullMQ. Every queue is registered; the billing clock and invoice PDF rendering are implemented, the rest are stubs. | 0 | 2 |
| [Contracts](Modules/Contracts.md) | package | Zod schemas shared by API and web. The request/response shape is written once and both sides import it. | 0 | 0 |
| [Documents](Modules/Documents.md) | api + package | Stores, retrieves and RENDERS every document the platform holds. One provider interface for the bytes (local disk in development, a private S3 bucket in production, nothing above the seam knows which) and one template function for the look — where the SAME function produces the on-screen preview and the printed PDF, so the two cannot drift. | 0 | 2 |
| [Tax](Modules/Tax.md) | package + api | Decides whether an issuer may charge tax on a supply at all, and only then at what rate. One set of rules, two issuers: rcln billing a clinic for its subscription, and a clinic billing a patient. | 0 | 4 |
| [Invoicing](Modules/Invoicing.md) | package + database + api | The clinic billing a PATIENT: one engine, many billable sources, the clinic's own registration, immutable once issued. ⚠️ NOT `subscription_invoices`, which is rcln billing the clinic and is complete — see §0.1 of the invoice-engine log for why the two cannot share a table. | 0 | 4 |
| [Inventory](Modules/Inventory.md) | package + database + api + worker + web | Where a thing IS and how much of it there is. The other half of the product catalogue, which has no quantity anywhere in it. One engine for medicines, consumables, devices, implants, reagents and dental materials — PI-2 of the pharmacy-inventory programme. | 0 | 7 |
